exam_blueprints_identity_ck.name: exam_blueprints_identity_ck
exam_blueprints_identity_ck.value: btrim("exam_blueprints"."exam_code") <> '' AND "exam_blueprints"."exam_code" = btrim("exam_blueprints"."exam_code") AND btrim("exam_blueprints"."version") <> '' AND "exam_blueprints"."version" = btrim("exam_blueprints"."version") AND btrim("exam_blueprints"."title") <> ''

exam_blueprints_verification_ck.name: exam_blueprints_verification_ck
exam_blueprints_verification_ck.value: ("exam_blueprints"."verified_at" IS NULL OR "exam_blueprints"."source_url" IS NOT NULL) AND ("exam_blueprints"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR "exam_blueprints"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

learning_sessions_completion_ck.name: learning_sessions_completion_ck
learning_sessions_completion_ck.value: ("learning_sessions"."status"='ACTIVE' AND "learning_sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("learning_sessions"."status"<>'ACTIVE' AND "learning_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_sessions"."completed_at">="learning_sessions"."created_at")

learning_session_items_tombstone_ck.name: learning_session_items_tombstone_ck
learning_session_items_tombstone_ck.value: ("learning_session_items"."question_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_session_items"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_session_items"."delivery_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_session_items"."deleted_question_code" IS NULL AND "learning_session_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "learning_session_items"."deletion_audit_id" IS NULL) OR ("learning_session_items"."question_id" IS NULL AND "learning_session_items"."revision_id" IS NULL AND "learning_session_items"."delivery_id" IS NULL AND "learning_session_items"."deleted_question_code" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_session_items"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_session_items"."deletion_audit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_session_items"."selected_option_key" IS NULL AND "learning_session_items"."flagged"=false AND "learning_session_items"."domain_snapshot"='[]'::jsonb)

curriculum_chapters_number_ck.name: curriculum_chapters_number_ck
curriculum_chapters_number_ck.value: ("curriculum_chapters"."volume"='V1' AND "curriculum_chapters"."chapter_number" BETWEEN 1 AND 29) OR ("curriculum_chapters"."volume"='V2' AND "curriculum_chapters"."chapter_number" BETWEEN 1 AND 19)
